# What the patient is told

> what the patient hears about their request

**Types:** `PatientView` (package Patient)

**Events out:** PatientInformed

[All topics](index.md)

## Rules

<a id="R15"></a>
### R15 — The patient hears about the request, forward only

`agreed` · behavioural · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02

The patient is told about their request, never about one tube, and only forward: a later milestone is never followed by an earlier one, so a late "in transit" cannot follow "at the lab". A repeat is told once.

- **Since:** refined by [R16](patient.md#R16)
- **Model:** `PatientView`
- **Shown by:** 01-two-tubes-to-the-lab, 09-a-late-scan-never-moves-the-patient-back

<a id="R16"></a>
### R16 — A failed request means a new sample is needed

`to-confirm` · behavioural · decided in session 1, 2026-03-02 · refines [R15](patient.md#R15)

When a request fails, the patient is told a new sample is needed; the doctor will ask again.

- **Model:** `PatientView.redraw_needed`, `patient_redraw`
- **Shown by:** 02-haemolysed-at-the-lab, 04-stability-expired
- **Open questions:** [Q-1](questions.md#Q-1)
